description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kottapola, Galigamuwa North D/S Division, Kegalle District (25/0299)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels, including detailed land particulars such as parcel numbers, extent, owner names, and location details. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters.
